prep.check: the installed entry gets the serial console; loader.conf as the installer wrote it
prep.detail:
title OpenBook
version 17 · slot A
sort-key openbook-1
linux /openbook/a/kernel
initrd /openbook/a/vendor_ramdisk.img
initrd /openbook/a/ramdisk.img
initrd /openbook/a/bootconfig.img
options firmware_class.path=/vendor/firmware log_buf_len=1M bootconfig console=ttyS0,115200 8250.nr_uarts=1 printk.devkmsg=on

prep.check: the installed disk boots slot a
an app installed with adb install
the base state recorded (marker, file, app, provisioned)
SELinux enforcing; the image's own boot HAL (AOSP default) runs

ab.check: g14-adb.sh ota: slot b written over adb, verified
ab.detail:
ot starts slot b next

Slot b is ready. Nothing changes until the next boot; slot a and /data are as they were.
  Reboot:     g14-adb.sh -a 127.0.0.1:38337 shell reboot      then: g14-adb.sh -a 127.0.0.1:38337 wait && g14-adb.sh -a 127.0.0.1:38337 ota-status
  Not yet:    g14-adb.sh -a 127.0.0.1:38337 ota-cancel        (before rebooting: slot a stays, as if nothing happened)
If slot b does not come up: it gets 3 tries. Hold the power button 10 s to force each restart; after the third
failed start systemd-boot starts slot a again by itself, with /data as it was. To pick a slot by hand: hold a k

ab.check: the first update's ESP step: bootsync from the package (running image has none)
ab.detail:
e up: it gets 3 tries. Hold the power button 10 s to force each restart; after the third
failed start systemd-boot starts slot a again by itself, with /data as it was. To pick a slot by hand: hold a key
